Economics Major Course Confusion – Need Advice from Seniors!
According to the official curriculum, ECO majors must take only one from:
ECO328 (International Economics) or 
ECO415 (Economic Development)
But then, the next required course, ECO348 / ECO349 (Economy of Bangladesh), lists ECO328 as a prerequisite — not ECO415.
 My confusion:
If I choose ECO415 (which should be valid), will I be blocked from taking ECO348, which is also mandatory?
Shouldn’t the prerequisite for ECO348 be "ECO328 or ECO415", since we’re allowed to take either one in the previous step?
If any seniors or faculty have faced this or know the correct interpretation, I’d really appreciate some guidance. 
Thanks in advance! See less

comments.label: Comment by Farhan Hoque Parab a year ago
comments.text: If you're from BBA, you must take at least one from 328 and 415. You can also take both, however, in that case, one of them will be counted as a major elective, and the other as a required major course. Also, Eco328 is probably not a prerequisite for 348, since I did both of them together. Mail the department chair to be assured.
